page.layout: One printed page: the digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara.ch banner, title block, licence notices and Visual Library logo). Nothing here belongs to the book's text; it is left out of the main text.
page.notes: The scan is the digitiser's cover sheet for the e-rara.ch copy of "In Hesterae historiam D. Rodolphi Gvaltheri, ministri Ecclesiae Tigurinae homiliarum sylvae vel archetypi. ..." by Gwalther (Rudolf Gwalther), Tiguri 1587, Zentralbibliothek Zürich, Shelf Mark 5.348, Persistent Link https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-4012. The logo, banner, shelf mark, link and licence text are the digitiser's own matter and are not transcribed as book text. No printed page of the 1587 book is present on this scan.
